viewing_check: Photograph the pump and motor nameplates (Gast model number, Dayton model, voltage; AU plug/240V or 110V US?). Open the case and confirm a hood/helmet, breathing tube, belt and fittings are present and perishable parts (hood visor, seals) are not perishing. Check the pump runs and the filter bowl is intact. A missing hood sharply cuts value to roughly the pump alone.
